Comment: The supplied text reports arm-specific completer counts, not arm-specific randomized counts: 330 were enrolled/randomized and 304 completed. Thus 94/103 for RIRS and 49/96 for SWL are derived completer-based counts, calculated by applying the reported percentages (91.3% and 51.0%) to the reported completer denominators and rounding to whole participants. They are not confirmed intention-to-treat counts and should not be treated as randomized-denominator data without additional full-text information.
